title: Moss and the Big Bunch
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 4, 67-sound stage (sl, sm, sn, sp just added). A true fact: hedgehogs gather grass and leaves to build a snug nest, and a big job like this is often easier with help.

pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog digging among tall green grass.

pages.text: Moss gets bits for a nest.
pages.illustration: Moss gathering small dry bits of grass and leaf for a nest.
Moss standing beside a big bunch of gathered nest material.

pages.text: The bunch is too big to lift.
pages.illustration: Moss straining to lift the big bunch without success.
Moss sitting back, unable to lift the heavy bunch alone.
Moss asking Nell the bee, who is resting nearby, for help.

pages.text: Nell and Moss lift the bunch.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and Moss the hedgehog lifting the bunch together.

pages.text: Moss and Nell get the bunch to the nest.
pages.illustration: Nell and Moss carrying the bunch together toward a snug nest.

pages.text: Moss naps snug in the nest.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog curled up asleep, snug inside the finished nest.
